_metadata.description: The delegated-provider contract with test-genie: ScenarioValidationService, maturity ladders, ExecutionMetrics, business-phase takeover, facade rerouting.

requirements.title: ScenarioValidationService with native detail
requirements.description: ValidateScenario answers the shared scenario-validation proto with a valid assessment, real ExecutionMetrics, and a BusinessContractReport native detail message (per-capability rollups, matrix rows, drift entries).

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/handlers/validation/handler_test.go. Fixture target yields valid assessment + metrics; native detail round-trips.

requirements.title: Provider-contract conformance on all five dimensions
requirements.description: test-genie provider-contract check business-health <target> --json passes all five dimensions; fleet-wide provider-contract scan reports no new hard violations from this provider.

validation.notes: Run test-genie provider-contract check + scan at Phase 7; record output in the phase log.

requirements.title: Delegated business phase preserves codes and posture
requirements.description: The business phase runs delegated with phase name, FINDING_SOURCE_BUSINESS, ordering, and the advisory severity cap (max ERROR, never BLOCKER) preserved; finding codes match the native phase so afids stay stable.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/assessment/severity_test.go. Severity cap enforced in the assessment builder; code-set parity assertions.

requirements.title: Maturity spec loads and matches identity
requirements.description: .vrooli/maturity.json loads via assessment.LoadSpecFromScenario, passes ValidateSpec, and RequireIdentity matches the scenario id; every emitted finding code appears in exactly one capability mapping.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/assessment/spec_test.go. Load + validate + identity + code-coverage assertions.

requirements.title: Facade rerouting keeps agent UX unchanged
requirements.description: vrooli scenario requirements <verb> routes contract verbs (validate, report, lint-prd, drift, phase, init, manual-log) to business-health and sync/snapshot to test-genie with no change in agent-facing UX.

validation.notes: Planned ref: internal/cli/scenariohandlers/tool_runtime_test.go. Route table assertions in the root CLI repo tests.

requirements.title: Legacy surfaces removed with fleet green
requirements.description: The retired control-tower scenario directory and scenario-auditor's prd_* shim provider are deleted; repo-wide grep finds references only in append-only history; test-genie, business-health, and scenario-auditor suites are green after removal.

validation.notes: Phase 11 final gates: provider-contract scan, fleet status, three suites, baseline diff vs the §9 anchor.
